snippet.title: VARLET - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
This isn't a story about finding someone else—it's about finding yourself.

"VARLET"
These students struggle to find their own answer while coping with the difficulties of growing up.
As you get to know them, you'll come to know more about yourself in this school life RPG.
PlayStation®5／Nintendo Switch™／Steam®／Epic Games

■Official Website
https://www.cs.furyu.jp/varlet/en/

■Official X
https://x.com/team_noir_info

♪Opening Theme Song
「Shiori」
Aruka Arisaka (CV:Minori Suzuki)
COMPOSER:wotaku

※The release date shown in the trailer is based on Japan Standard Time, so the date may vary depending on each region.
